conversation.title: AI Conversation
conversation.whatIsItDesc: AI Conversation is an interactive feature that allows you to practice speaking English with an AI tutor. The AI listens to your speech, understands your message, and responds naturally to help you improve your pronunciation, vocabulary, and conversational skills.
conversation.step1: Click 'TAP TO SPEAK' and grant microphone access
conversation.step2: Speak naturally - the AI will listen and understand your message
conversation.step3: Listen to the AI's response and continue the conversation
